From now on, always run the linter before committing.
The new rule is: every commit message must reference a ticket number.
Always write a changelog entry for every public API change.
From now on, the default branch name for new repos is 'main', not 'master'.
Never skip code review for changes touching the payment flow, from now on.
Always squash commits before merging a feature branch, from now on.
Never again will we store secrets in a config file committed to git.
Always use snake_case for database column names from now on.
From now on, never write directly to the shared staging database.
The new house style for all diagrams uses the navy and gold palette, never the old blue and grey one.
Never again skip the changelog when cutting a release.
The new rule: feature flags must be removed within 30 days of full rollout.
Always name test files with a _test suffix from now on.
Never again merge a branch with failing CI.
The new rule going forward is that config changes require a second reviewer.
From now on, never store API keys in plaintext anywhere in the repo.
Always include a rollback step in every deployment runbook, from now on.
